decisions.reason: As the publicly presented flagship, its high sunk costs and visible commitment make management persist with it rather than write off the investment.
It is a product line with several models close to the firm's established offer, so the investment and public mention incline management to keep it despite any disappointing results.
Although less prominently featured than A or D, it builds on the established offer and was publicly mentioned, so management is likely to justify and continue it.
As a luminaire family with its own webpage and multiple models, its visible commitment and sunk costs make dropping it unlikely under escalation of commitment.
